raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 was re-delivered at 05:00 with 333 transaction IDs duplicated from the 02:00 copy; the copies differ only in ingest_ts, and silver_transactions keeps both, which doubles the 2026-01-18 volume and inflates every gold table. Deduplicating silver_transactions on txn_id, keeping the latest ingest_ts, removes the duplicates without changing any business values.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED' QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC) = 1;"}}
